sketches.study_axis: worn piano-like strike and near-unison ring / slightly stronger detune
sketches.intent: r2 of Low Battery Piano: static FM ratio 1.003 to 1.006. Original MIDI, amplitude/FM/filter envelopes, tone, Output, tap mix and all LFO/drift settings unchanged; more relative separation rather than extra vibrato. Velocity opens the shared Tone filter, not a separate filter per key.
